mkdir -p /tmp/pptest && cat > /tmp/pptest/t.py <<'EOF'
import sys, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.nn.functional as F
sys.path.insert(0, "/tmp/obench-cell-usc5ii_l/bench_opencode_torch-pipeline-parallelism_dmt8enzj")
from pipeline_parallel import train_step_pipeline_afab
from transformers import LlamaConfig, LlamaForCausalLM
dist.init_process_group("gloo")
r, ws = dist.get_rank(), dist.get_world_size()
torch.manual_seed(0)
cfg = LlamaConfig(vocab_size=100, hidden_size=32, intermediate_size=64, num_hidden_layers=5, num_attention_heads=4, num_key_value_heads=2)
m = LlamaForCausalLM(cfg); ref = LlamaForCausalLM(cfg); ref.load_state_dict(m.state_dict())
x = torch.randint(0,100,(8,16)); y = torch.randint(0,100,(8,16))
xs, ys = list(x.chunk(4)), list(y.chunk(4))
loss = train_step_pipeline_afab(m, xs, ys, torch.device("cpu"), torch.float32)
lr = 0
for a,b in zip(xs, ys):
    l = F.cross_entropy(ref(a).logits.reshape(-1,100), b.reshape(-1))/4; l.backward(); lr += l.item()
maxd = 0; cnt=0
for (n,p),(_,q) in zip(m.named_parameters(), ref.named_parameters()):
    if p.grad is not None:
        cnt+=1; maxd = max(maxd, (p.grad-q.grad).abs().max().item())
print(r, "loss", loss, lr, "params w/ grad", cnt, "maxdiff", maxd)
dist.destroy_process_group()
EOF
cd /tmp/pptest && torchrun --nproc_per_node=1 t.py 2>&1 | tail -3; torchrun --nproc_per_node=2 t.py 2>&1 | tail -3
